ZAF.note: Only SARS statements on human review and governance of its own AI; no rule or authority on AI harms.

facts.fact: SARS says its AI assistant Ask Lwazi now handles more than 3 million interactions a year that SARS officials previously handled.

SARS says its entity compliance models segment its base of more than 36 million tax entities, detect anomalies and potential fraud, and support risk assessment and case selection, and that it has applied advanced analytics and AI for more than a decade.
SARS says its debt-collection propensity models help prioritise its debt book and target interventions, enabling it to collect more than R110 billion a year.

ZAF.note: Document reports the President's call for a national AI action plan within 90 days; no drafting begun is stated.
